contracts.README.md: Env-style config: KEY=value lines, optional surrounding whitespace, or full-line # comments. Keys match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. Values are strings trimmed at edges but otherwise literal, including equals signs and inline #. Duplicate keys use the last value. Empty values are allowed; malformed lines throw ENV_SYNTAX. parseEnv returns an ordinary object with own data properties; __proto__ is valid. resolveEnv returns a copy. loadConfig(entry,read) uses an injected async reader returning text. Exports are src/index.mjs.
contracts.task:
Extend resolveEnv(values) to recursively expand ${KEY} references to other own keys, including forward references.
$$ produces one literal dollar and prevents that pair from beginning an expansion; replacement text is not rescanned after its referenced value is resolved.
Unknown referenced keys throw ENV_UNDEFINED with .key
cycles throw ENV_CYCLE
loadConfig must expand after parsing, while parseEnv remains literal.

baseline.src/parse.mjs: export function parseEnv(text){const entries=[];for(const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)){const trimmed=line.trim();if(!trimmed||trimmed.startsWith('#'))continue;const at=trimmed.indexOf('='),key=trimmed.slice(0,at).trim(),value=at<0?undefined:trimmed.slice(at+1);if(!/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(key)||value===undefined)throw Object.assign(new Error('syntax'),{code:'ENV_SYNTAX'});entries.push([key,value.trim()]);}return Object.fromEntries(entries);}
baseline.src/load.mjs: import {parseEnv} from './parse.mjs';import {resolveEnv} from './resolve.mjs';export async function loadConfig(entry,read){return resolveEnv(parseEnv(await read(entry)));}
baseline.test/public.test.mjs: import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {parseEnv,resolveEnv,loadConfig} from '../src/index.mjs';test('key/value config',async()=>{assert.deepEqual(parseEnv('# comment\nA=one\nB=two'),{A:'one',B:'two'});assert.deepEqual(resolveEnv({A:'one'}),{A:'one'});assert.deepEqual(await loadConfig('main.env',async()=> 'A=one'),{A:'one'});});
